## Selected campaign: Bristol Toddler Takeover

### Verified facts

- **What:** relaxed transport-themed museum day with games, craft activities, interactive story time, instruments and puppets; ticket includes M Shed permanent displays.
- **Who:** specially designed for children under 4 with their adults.
- **When:** Monday 12 October 2026, 10:00–14:00.
- **Cost:** £8 combined adult-and-child ticket; additional child £4.
- **Booking:** tickets are on sale through Bristol Museums' official Pretix page.
- **Practicalities:** craft activities are drop-in and first come, first served. The café and shop will be closed; families may bring a picnic.
- **Final safety check:** recheck availability, times and prices shortly before scheduling.

### Instagram/Facebook caption — complete draft

Bristol parents of vehicle-obsessed toddlers: this one’s yours. 🚂🚌✈️

On **Monday 12 October**, M Shed is opening on its usual closed day for a relaxed takeover made especially for under-4s.

Tiny explorers can get stuck into transport games and crafts, join an interactive story with puppets and instruments, then roam the permanent museum galleries — without the usual bustle.

📍 M Shed  
🕙 10am–2pm  
🎟 £8 for one adult + one child  
➕ Extra child £4

One useful heads-up: crafts are drop-in and first come, first served. The café and shop will be closed, so pack a picnic.

Save this for the toddler who shouts “BUS!” at every window. Full details and booking: https://donext.co.uk/bristol/

#BristolKids #BristolFamilies #ThingsToDoBristol #ToddlerLife #MShED #DoNextBristol

## Next-weekend Friday draft — 3–4 October

Draft only; it still needs the Friday 2 October source recheck and finished carousel artwork.

**Caption**

NEXT weekend in Bristol — **Saturday 3 and Sunday 4 October** — has cranes you can climb inside, a castle that rarely opens its doors, a nature-detective trail and an indoor games fallback.

🏗 **M Shed crane visits** — Sat + Sun from 11am. See the working electric cranes from inside. Volunteer-operated and weather-dependent, so check before setting off.

🏰 **Blaise Castle open afternoon** — Sun, 2–4.30pm, with a volunteer talk at 3pm and battlement views.

🦌 **Dyrham Park nature detectives** — Sat + Sun, 10am–4pm. Follow the children’s trail through the park and garden; £2 booklet plus admission, no booking needed.

🎲 **Central Library DIY Games Day** — Sun, 1–4.45pm, for ages 2–17. A useful indoor fallback; confirm the recurring session before travel.

Save this now, then check the final Friday update at https://donext.co.uk/bristol/

## Subscriber email — drafted, not sent

**Subject:** A tiny transport takeover at M Shed 🚂  
**Preview:** A quieter museum Monday built just for Bristol’s under-4s.

If your toddler can spot a bus at fifty paces, put Monday 12 October in the diary.

M Shed is opening on its usual closed day for a relaxed transport-themed takeover for under-4s. There will be games and crafts, an interactive story with puppets and instruments, and access to the permanent galleries.

It runs 10am–2pm. A combined adult-and-child ticket is £8 and an extra child is £4. Crafts are first come, first served, and the café and shop will be shut, so bring a picnic.

**See the details and book:** https://donext.co.uk/bristol/

Please recheck ticket availability before travelling.
